user.title: Lupus Cloud
user.description: Log in with your lupuscloud.com account.

areas.title: Assign rooms to areas
areas.description: Choose a Home Assistant area for each Lupus room that contains devices. The devices are added to that area. Devices in rooms without an area are not added. You can change this later in the integration options.

reconfigure.title: Change Lupus Cloud password
reconfigure.description: Enter the current password for {username}, e.g. after you changed it in the Lupus Cloud.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Lupus Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: The login for {username} has expired. Please enter your password again.

error.invalid_code: Invalid or expired code. Please log in again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Lupus Cloud.
error.no_rooms: Assign at least one room to an area.

abort.wrong_account: You logged in with a different account.

init.title: Lupus Cloud options
init.description:
Webhook status: {webhook_status}

Alarms are pushed instantly via webhook. Measurements are polled at the interval below.

data.webhook_url_override: Public Home Assistant URL for the webhook (optional)

data_description.alarm_events: Only these events switch the alarm sensors on and fire the lupuscloud_alarm event. All events are still available as lupuscloud_webhook / lupuscloud_notification events.
data_description.webhook_url_override: Only needed if Home Assistant has no external URL and no Home Assistant Cloud. Enter the public base address of your Home Assistant (without /api/...).

areas.title: Assign rooms to areas
areas.description: Choose a Home Assistant area for each Lupus room that contains devices. Devices in rooms without an area are not added (existing ones are removed).

abort.not_loaded: The integration is currently not loaded. Please try again in a moment.

error.invalid_url: Please enter a valid http(s) URL.

options.warning_device: Device warning (e.g. malfunction, smoke openings blocked)

new_rooms.title: Lupus Cloud: new devices found
new_rooms.description: There are new devices in rooms that have not been offered for assignment yet: {rooms}. They are not added until you assign the room to an area: open the Lupus Cloud integration and select Configure. Leave the room empty and save to dismiss this message.

no_external_url.title: Lupus Cloud: no external URL for alarms
no_external_url.description: Home Assistant has no external URL, so the Lupus Cloud cannot push alarms. Alarms are only detected by polling. Configure an external URL, Home Assistant Cloud or set the webhook URL in the integration options.

webhook_registration_failed.title: Lupus Cloud: webhook could not be registered
webhook_registration_failed.description: The webhook for instant alarms could not be registered in the Lupus Cloud: {error}
